verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair axis for an observability platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence shows only alerting: triggers and SLO burn alerts can be routed to PagerDuty, Slack, Teams or webhooks, and deploy markers can be added. Nothing shows Honeycomb itself declaring or tracking incidents, keeping incident timelines, or managing on-call schedules or escalation policies; that work falls to external tools like PagerDuty.
